title: Cellar and Smile
author: Mirabel Eriksen
blurb: Ada Yarrow, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
